title: Average medical cost in the year after an emergency department visit for a bicycle injury
source: Peterson C, Xu L, Florence C. Average medical cost of fatal and non-fatal injuries by type in the USA. Injury Prevention 2021;27(1):24-33. Table: estimated 12-month attributable cost of medical care following emergency department treatment for all patients with non-fatal injuries, by mechanism and intent (unintentional), 2015 US dollars (MarketScan claims, injuries Oct 2014-Sep 2015).

price_update.index: US Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI-U Medical care, US city average (CUUS0000SAM), not seasonally adjusted

note: Medical care only (not lost work or quality of life). Averages for people with employer-based insurance, covering both patients sent home and patients admitted. Bicycle injury costs are applied to e-bike injuries; e-bike injuries lead to hospital stays slightly more often, so their true cost may be higher. Low end = every injury costs like an other bicycle injury; high end = every injury costs like a road crash with a motor vehicle.
